description: Card: the story series as a grid of 9:16 previews playing in place; the user selects one and confirms. Free, spends nothing. It is the answer to 'what series are there': call it when they want a story episode and the user has not named one. NOT when they named one or ask its prices (`list_series` with `series_id`), or no card renders (a terminal): use `list_series` and a text shortlist. If the user says they cannot see a picker, use `list_series` and do not call this again. AFTER: one line, then STOP. Do not list or describe the series, call `list_series` to see the grid, or ask in text too. The pick arrives as their message. The card stays live: if a later message names another series, THE LATER MESSAGE WINS COMPLETELY: drop the old one; never merge the two or ask which. The result only names the catalogue: do not paste it.
name: browse_series
title: Show the AI Video Story series as a picker
